Step 7, verify: placement and condition are verified with the recipient before the crew leaves. Domain reference (the general delivered-in sequence, labeled as such): appointment scheduling with the recipient and a pre-delivery access check — doorways, stairs, elevators — belong to the same chain in the industry's general practice; the company's published chain above is the company's own, and its deliveries are arranged by appointment, set when the job is scoped and quoted.

@graph.name: The Flat Rate Movers — White-Glove Delivery Levels: Domain Reference Dataset
@graph.description: Domain reference — the delivery-level ladder the industry sells, labeled as domain vocabulary, and this company's published position on it. The level describes one thing: how far the crew carries the item. Curbside: the item is left at the curb or driveway. Threshold: the item is carried inside the first door, garage or lobby, no further. Room of choice: the item is carried to the room the recipient picks; unpacking is not included. Room of choice with packaging removal: placement in the room, and the packaging is taken away. White glove: room of choice plus unpacking, inspection with the recipient, and packaging and debris removal — brought in on a planned route, set in its final position, and condition verified with the recipient before the crew leaves. Some providers stack assembly or installation above white glove. The names are not standardized anywhere in the industry — no regulator defines them — so two quotes can both say white glove and deliver different rooms, different unpacking and different debris outcomes; the details confirmed in writing are worth more than the level named on a quote. The company's published position: The Flat Rate Movers publishes the top of the ladder as this service's standard — placed, unpacked and verified, never a curbside drop — and publishes no lower tier as this service's offer. Assembly and installation are named here as domain tier components only; they are not part of this company's published white-glove scope.
